description.part1: Inject your GTM container on learner enrollment pages. This enables conversion tracking, remarketing pixels, and any tags you configure in your GTM workspace. An
description.part2: event is pushed to the dataLayer on successful registration.

containerId.label: Container ID
containerId.hint: Find your Container ID in GTM → Admin → Container Settings.

errors.invalidContainerId: Invalid GTM Container ID. Expected format: GTM-XXXXXXX

card.title: UTM Link Builder
card.description: Generate campaign-tagged links for audience forms, live sessions, assessments, enrolment invites, product pages and catalogue sites. Off by default — when on, a “Generate UTM link” action appears in each of those share menus.

utm.surfacesHint: Applies to: audience forms, live sessions, assessments, enrolment invites, product pages and catalogue sites.

sources.label: Allowed sources
sources.hint: Comma separated. Offered first in the builder so campaign naming stays consistent.

mediums.label: Allowed mediums
mediums.hint: Comma separated. Offered first in the builder so campaign naming stays consistent.

requireCampaign.label: Require a campaign name
requireCampaign.hint: Blocks generating a link until utm_campaign is filled in. Source and medium without a campaign is the usual reason a report is unreadable.

anyPage.label: Build a link for any other page
anyPage.hint: The login, sign-up or any landing page has no share menu. Pick one or type a path, then generate the tagged link.
